reading: On this synthetic corpus every sample of the contrast group carries a global offset of about 0.19 log2 above the other two groups (a depth pattern of the calibration recipe), so with no between-sample normalisation the group ANOVA is significant for every protein and the script's optimiser has no control set. The route's optional protein_between_sample_normalisation step (cyclic loess) removes the offset entirely: no protein is then significant and the sweep finds its control sets. The DIA route's journey on the same corpus runs cyclic loess before its RUV sweep (475 controls at 19 % on kit-journey-036). The screen corpus (8 samples) is unaffected: 100 controls at 4 % with norm_method = none.
decision: The counted full-corpus member binds norm_method = cyclicloess (the route's offered option; kernels, engine and claim unchanged); the none result stands as a valid unfavourable result on this corpus and is not retried. Recorded for the user's review (afk).
